facts.fact: The PATN project unit says its connectivity component aims to deploy 200 km of fibre and cover 500 localities with 3G/4G, including rural and peri-urban areas.
facts.system: Projet d'Appui à la Transformation Numérique du Tchad (PATN)

TCD.note: Only a national digital and financial literacy strategy is to be drawn up; no programme for the public is stated.
Payments digitisation is named only as a framework aim, with no government payment programme.
A PPP model is intended, but no private amount or signed deal is stated.
Disaster recovery for public data is a stated aim only; no backup site is named.
No mobile money service is described.
No tax or fee payment system is described.
